storyCards.headline: Stone Cold: A Cultural Moment Captured on Record
storyCards.fact:
Rainbow's "Stone Cold" reached #40 on the Billboard Hot 100.

The song peaked at #40 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 12 weeks on the chart.

Stone Cold was released in 1982.

Album: Straight Between The Eyes (1982).
